assumptions: Checkpoint interval (10/25/50 mi) is a user-selectable sampling interval. The default is 25.
Risk per checkpoint is the worst of wind, rain, and snow after load rules. Wind is sustained 10 m speed, not gusts.
Moderate, High, and Severe lower bounds are inclusive. Wind No Travel is >= 55 mph. Rain No Travel is > 1.00 in/hr. Snow No Travel is > 3.0 in/hr.
ETA is proportional to distance along the route using the routing API's total duration. Durations are car-based; there is no HGV speed adjustment.
The forecast hour is the nearest whole UTC hour to the ETA. Open-Meteo hourly precipitation is the total for that hour, treated as in/hr. Snow is snowfall depth in/hr.
Heatmap hour h is the weather at departure + h along the corridor, independent of where the truck is.
Ranking is lexicographic: fewest Severe miles, then fewest High miles, then lowest average risk, then shortest travel time. Blocked routes are disqualified unless every route is blocked.
Units are US-focused: mph, pounds, and inches.
Rain is Open-Meteo rain plus showers. Coordinates are rounded to 0.1 degree before the forecast lookup. Unknown miles are left out of average risk and are not counted as Low.
Open-Meteo forecast_days runs from today (UTC), not from departure. The request covers departure + 72h and is capped at 16 days. Heatmap hours outside that window are unknown (-1), not Low.
